purpose: Register two official reference sources for the second CONFIRMED and LEGITIMATE acquisition channels without mutating the hash-pinned V1 source registry or acquiring records.

sources.name: CFTC Registration Deficient List
sources.raw_label_semantics: Foreign entity appears to act in a capacity requiring CFTC registration but is not registered; listing is not a CFTC or court finding that a violation occurred.

terms_review.finding: CFTC states that government information on its website is public domain and may be copied and distributed with appropriate acknowledgement; third-party contributed or licensed items may remain protected.
terms_review.operational_decision: Reference metadata may be retained for internal academic research with source acknowledgement. Initial acquisition is manual or through an explicit official download only; no generic scraper is authorized by this review.
terms_review.redistribution_decision: Do not redistribute third-party media or full page bundles without a separate item-level rights review.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR Submissions and Filing Data
sources.raw_label_semantics: Official public filing and submission metadata; filing or registration is not a content-safety label and does not guarantee legitimacy of every communication.

terms_review.finding: SEC permits automated public-data access subject to its website Privacy and Security Policy, including a current aggregate limit of no more than 10 requests per second and classification of the automated client.
terms_review.operational_decision: Use only documented SEC APIs or bulk archives, identify the research client, cap at one request per second, cache immutable raw responses, and stop on throttling or policy changes.
terms_review.execution_blocker: A truthful project contact identity must be configured in the request User-Agent before any scripted SEC request.

registry_policy.reason_for_addendum: The parent registry is hash-pinned by frozen historical analyses; mutating it would invalidate reproducibility.
